name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan Horvat's journey into motorsport HR wasn't a straight shot; he started in logistics after a business degree in Zagreb. He quickly discovered a knack for talent acquisition and development, realizing that effective teams are the engine of any successful operation. His sharp eye for potential, coupled with a deep understanding of team dynamics, led him to specialize in HR, eventually landing him at Stewart-Haas Racing.

At SHR, Ivan is known for his meticulous approach to building a high-performance culture. He believes in fostering a work environment where ambition is rewarded and individual contributions are recognized. While some might see him as a bit of a lone wolf, his dedication to finding and nurturing the best talent is undeniable. Ivan's perfectionist tendencies ensure that every HR process is optimized to support the team's competitive edge. 

He's not afraid to challenge the status quo and is constantly looking for innovative ways to improve SHR's HR strategies. Ivan understands that a well-oiled human resources machine is just as crucial as a finely-tuned engine on the track.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ivan is a man of medium build with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought during meetings.
Secretly proud of his extensive collection of HR management books.
